scope: Offline partial observation of requests.get dispatches saved by adaptive collectors, network-healthchecks and bounded diagnostics; event-time cutoff applied retrospectively to a fixed input-file inventory. No network requests made.

grain.event: one requests.get call admitted to dispatch; robots/redirect/preflight included
grain.start_field: http_get_started_at after host/global wait, immediately before requests.get; admission/call time, not network packet arrival
grain.deduplication_key: UTC-normalized http_get_started_at; cross-check aliases agree on canonical actual response URL and HTTP status
grain.url_rule: url when available (capture replaces requested_url with original chain URL); fallback requested_url only without response.url
grain.origin_rule: lowercase scheme and hostname plus non-default port; http/https and www/bare are separate origins; explicit default :443/:80 normalized
grain.windows: half-open [focal request started_at - minutes, focal started_at); focal GET excluded
grain.http_get_attempted_false: excluded at the outer node; real nested robots/redirect nodes still traversed
grain.unknown_older_timing: retrieved_at / legacy started_at never substituted for actual dispatch time
grain.counts_are_lower_bounds: 57 earlier collector attempts have no matching saved actual start; omitted calls outside these sources not observed
grain.freeze_rule: Only actual dispatch starts <= event_time_cutoff admitted; files read later can contain later data, excluded by event time. Results are retrospective event-time observations, not an exact archived live monitor screen.

active_batch_counter_observation.get_count_scope: requests.get attempts, including robots and redirects; total also includes preflight

quality.active_counter_note: Fixed progress counter has its own observed_at, before event-time cutoff; never sum progress + final or wrapper + collection count.
quality.snapshot_write_time_note: Source inventory/bytes were read after the cutoff. Included request starts are <= cutoff; a late-persisted request result may be present. This does not add later request starts.
quality.safe_header_date_note: Date is not used for dispatch times: recovered339A robots404 hasDate07:16:37GMT while actual GET started07:47:43.899176UTC. An old Date alone does not identify cache state or cause.

limitations: The first six closed collectors counted 1706 actual GET attempts, but only1649 saved unique dispatch starts; 57 missing matches are not necessarily57 raw fields missing, nor can they be timed or assigned an origin.
Collector totals include exceptions, robots, redirects and preflight. Count of HTTP200 responses is not count of company pages or verified IR contact channels.
5/15/30/60-minute windows do not include uninstrumented requests before the first saved dispatch or outside this source scope; counts are observed lower bounds.
Proxy-side quota, connection state, resources and request arrival logs are unavailable; timestamps reflect local call admission.
RPS, cooldown, elapsed exposure, site mix, route reuse, collector code versions and TLS failures changed together; this is observational rather than controlled causal evidence.
No HTTP429 or savedRateLimit headers; one301 redirect carriesRetry-After:0. This does not prove the proxy has no internal throttling.

A finite monotonic lifetime cap without replenishment/reset cannot by itself explain later recovered200 responses after a higher cumulative observed count; reset/replenishing quota remains compatible.
Failures and successes at0.25RPS refute that0.25 is universally safe or that configured instantaneous rate alone separates the cases; no safe threshold is estimated.
